versions.changelog: Ownership migrated to the trustgrowth org; content unchanged from 1.0.0

eeat-review v1.0.0 - Initial release

- Provides E-E-A-T (Experience, Expertise, Authoritativeness, Trustworthiness) review using TrustGrowth evidence or observable public/repository signals.
- Evaluates credibility, authorship, and trust signals based on what is accessible; never fabricates inputs or predicts outcomes.
- Categorizes recommendations into code-fixable, content-fixable (requiring human input), and structural/off-page.
- Follows strict evidence and ethics guidelines; delivers value while respecting owner approval and input.
- Clarifies when to use alternative review skills for backlink authority, site fixes, or AI visibility analysis.
